purpose: Bind the existing unified B2B/A2A marketplace to the chosen commercial verticals without creating replacement products, prices, payment links, ledgers, or silo-crossing routes.

commercial_verticals.economic_role: paid evidence-depth tier inside the existing Truth Oracle product
required_gates: existing Truth Oracle tier and entitlement contract reconciled
live catalogue and provider price read-back
source-linked output and explicit evidence depth
settlement attribution and metering idempotency
reproducible artifact plus hash and retrievable delivery receipt
privacy retention and refund/dispute path verified
owner-approved activation

commercial_verticals.economic_role: digital avatar cosmetics and identity customization
commercial_verticals.inventory_authority: existing DreamMeez catalogue and entitlement subsystem only
required_gates: canonical cosmetic SKU and price match the live provider object
account-bound authenticated buyer identity
provider-confirmed settled payment
signature-verified webhook and idempotent server-side entitlement grant
client roles cannot self-grant ownership
buyer-retrievable entitlement/delivery receipt
duplicate-event and retry tests pass
owner-approved release

commercial_verticals.display_name: Billboard ads (web-native today; physical DOOH integration pending)
commercial_verticals.economic_role: The current public billboard is a web-native tile. Physical DOOH is a proposed adapter, not an integrated or verified media inventory.
commercial_verticals.inventory_authority: existing billboard-v2 inventory subsystem only; physical inventory source is not yet verified
required_gates: server-authoritative finite inventory and reservation
independently verified physical screen partner and inventory feed
publisher/screen-partner impression or delivery logs for any physical DOOH claim
approved creative, destination and advertiser terms
canonical amount, currency and live checkout match
provider-confirmed settled payment with idempotent attribution
recorded placement schedule and actual delivery/measurement evidence
buyer-retrievable placement report and receipt
human approval before public placement
owner-approved release

economic_validation.pass_condition: independent buyer -> authorized live checkout -> provider-confirmed settled payment -> exact vertical/SKU attribution -> completed fulfillment -> retrievable delivery evidence -> independent ledger reconciliation
